name: time_zone
description:
The default timezone to be used in the query. Defaults to UTC, and overrides the `time_zone` request parameter. See [timezones](https://www.elastic.co/docs/reference/query-languages/esql/esql-rest#esql-timezones).

The `esql.query.settings.time_zone` cluster setting changes the default for every query on the cluster. A value given here or in the request body overrides it. {applies_to}`stack: ga 9.6+`
